page.description: Welcome to the PropertyList WhatsApp Community guide. Stop working in isolation and tap directly into Andalucía's most active real estate network. This guide explains how to access our verified co-broking groups, broadcast your priority listings to active agents who already hold the buyers, and negotiate deals in real-time - putting the region's top property professionals right in your pocket.
page.body:
WhatsApp Community Groups: The Co-Broking Network


Real estate moves fast. Stop relying on passive communication and tap directly into Andalucía & Spains most active, high-intent co-broking WhatsApp network. 

The PropertyList WhatsApp Community is an exclusive infrastructure designed to put the region's top property professionals right in your pocket. It allows you to broadcast priority listings directly to the agents who already hold the buyers, source specific properties for your clients, and negotiate deals in real-time.

Ecosystem Access & The Malaga Waitlist


To maintain a high standard of professional co-broking, our community groups are not open to the general public. Access is strictly reserved for verified agents who have officially joined the PropertyList platform. 

Due to unprecedented demand, our dedicated Malaga Area Groups are currently at maximum capacity. We are currently operating a strict waiting list for new agents wishing to enter this highly lucrative network.

How to Bypass the Waitlist: "Priority Access"


At PropertyList, we reward active listers who contribute to the ecosystem. 

While passive agents will remain on the waiting list, we grant Priority Access to agents who actively share their PropertyList listings to the network.

If you are consistently uploading your portfolio to the Smart MLS and sharing those digital listings with the community, you are providing immense value to other agents. To reward this, we will fast-track your entry and grant you immediate access to the Malaga groups - even if they are officially at maximum capacity.

Expanding the Grid: Request a New Area


As the PropertyList infrastructure expands across the region, we are continuously deploying new community hubs. By request, we will create new, dedicated WhatsApp groups for new areas as we onboard and verify agents in those specific locations.

If your primary operating sector does not yet have a dedicated group, please send a direct message to the admin team via your dashboard to request its creation. 

Why Active Participation is Your Best Strategy


By treating the WhatsApp Community as a strategic extension of your CRM, you transform how you do business:
Instant Distribution: When you list a new development or an exclusive mandate on PropertyList, sharing the generated MicroSite link to the WhatsApp group instantly notifies active professionals.
Contextual Networking: Stop sending cold emails. When another agent requests a specific property type in the chat, you can instantly reply with your PropertyList link, answering their problem exactly when they need it.
Verified Trust: Because every member must be joined to PropertyList, you know you are dealing with verified professionals, drastically reducing time wasted on unqualified leads. 

How to Get Started

1.  Register: Ensure your agency is signed up and verified on PropertyList.es.
2.  Upload: Add your direct listings to the MLS (multi-listing-platform).
3.  Request Access: Contact our support team to request your WhatsApp Community invitation, or message the admin to request a new area group. Remember to let us know you are actively uploading listings to secure your Priority Access.
